g.text: Flood-scale check: model one-day inflow against the figures the public record holds

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #52514e; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linecap: square

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Volumes over the flood periods sit near the reported means; the model's largest days fall short of the stated peaks. Reported peaks are readings at a moment and the model's day is

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: a daily volume, so the peak ratios are lower bounds. Pong 24 Sep 2025 is a recession day where the base-flow stand-in runs high.
